Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 다음엔 꼭 성공할 거라며 분통을 터트렸다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Having failed the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> fumes and swears to definitely succeed next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、次こそ成功させると悔しがっている。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>气愤地说下次一定要成功。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>氣憤地說下次一定要成功。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Le <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> qui a échoué la mission a juré de réussir la prochaine fois.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach der fehlgeschlagenen Quest kochte <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vor Wut und schwor, es beim nächsten Mal unbedingt zu schaffen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Al haber fallado la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> echa humo y jura que la próxima vez tendrá éxito.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Tendo falhado na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> fervia de raiva e jurou que da próxima vez teria sucesso.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ทำภารกิจล้มเหลวก็เดือดดาล และสาบานว่าจะต้องทำให้สำเร็จในครั้งหน้าให้ได้
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bersumpah akan berhasil lain kali dan melampiaskan amarahnya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bực tức và thề sẽ thành công trong lần tới.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: क्वेस्ट में असफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> गुस्से से भर गया और अगली बार निश्चित रूप से सफल होने की कसम खाता है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ดี! พยายามเข้านะ!
นี่ รับไปสิ

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I headed back with <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, who was back to her old self.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 元気を取り戻した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>と、一緒に宿へと戻った。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我和恢复活力的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>一起回来了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 我和恢復活力的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>一起回來了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Je suis retourné avec <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, qui avait retrouvé son entrain.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ich kehrte mit <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> zurück, die wieder ganz die Alte war.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Regresé con <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, quien ya estaba de vuelta a la normalidad.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Voltei com <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que estava de volta ao seu eu normal.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันกลับมาพร้อมกับ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่กลับมาเป็นเหมือนเดิมแล้ว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Aku kembali bersama <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang sudah kembali seperti semula.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tôi quay lại cùng với <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, người đã trở lại là chính mình.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मैं <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के साथ वापस चला गया, जो अपने पुराने रूप में वापस आ गई थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Even on the way back, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s anger refused to cool.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 帰り道でも、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の怒りは収まらなかった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 回来的时候<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的怒气依然未消。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 回來的時候<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的怒氣依然未消。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Même en revenant, la part de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> n'a pas été réduite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Als du zurückkamst, war die Kleidung von <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nicht mehr an.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Incluso cuando regresó, el aura de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> no se desvaneció.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Mesmo quando você voltou, o <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> não estava em casa.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เมื่อคุณกลับมา <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังไม่ได้ใส่กางเกงเลย
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Bahkan saat kembali, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tidak pernah beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Ngay cả khi trở lại, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn giữ nguyên vẻ ngoài của mình.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: वापस जाते समय भी, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का गुस्सा शांत नहीं हुआ।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est réjoui(e) après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ficou feliz ao receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गया।
